info.title: Kawagoe Boys Sing -Now or Never-
info.synopsis: Una commedia scolastica che racconta delle crescita dei membri del club di coro maschile della Kawagoe e del loro istruttore, un ex direttore d'orchestra chiamato Haruo Hibiki. Le personalità dei membri del club spesso si scontrano ma Haruo li aiuta a crescere insieme cantando mentre mirano ai nazionali del concorso canoro maschile.

episodes.title: On the set
episodes.synopsis: Tenshi, Ei-chan, and Shiratori all attend Kawagoe Academy. One day, they get pulled into the orbit of former conductor Haruo. He drags them into his newly founded boys choir where they suddenly find themselves performing a song in front of an audience!

episodes.title: Verso un domani colmo di luce
episodes.synopsis: The boys choir doesn't have enough members to compete in the Kanto choir competition. Luckily, the principal has found two likely, if quirky, candidates. But it might not be so easy to get them to join the choir.

episodes.title: Altezze a confronto

episodes.title: LA LA LA
episodes.synopsis: The principal has found an interesting video on NewTube. She has Rika and Haruo listen to it. Haruo decides that since the singers are more "yes" than "no," he needs to find them and add them to the choir. But the choir will have to catch them first!

episodes.title: Summer Blessing
episodes.synopsis: Now that the choir has ten members, it's time to get serious about entering the Kanto boys choir competition! The boys find out that last year's national winners are performing at a festival, so they go to check them out. Then they run into Maiden's dad!

episodes.title: Pigne
